spans.s:
cid, encl. pcl.
 —1. emphasizes, sometimes
very gently, the preceding word: even,
7810, 15; just, 74^2, 79^4; yāś cid, what
very ones, 70^16; at least, 79^14;
 —2. generalizes
a pron.: yé cid…tā́ṃś cid, whatsoever…,
 unto all those, 91^10; so far
Vedic;
 —3. in classical Skt., very common
w. an interr., rendering it indef.: kaś cid,
a certain; na kā cid, not any; see ka,
kad, kadā, karhi, kva. [acc. s. n. of
pron. root ka, ki (505), w. palatalization:
1111a.]
